name: HoverCard
description: A hover card previews what a link points to, such as a person’s profile, when a mouse user points at it or a keyboard user focuses it. The link itself must lead to the same information.
whenToUse: To preview a linked person, product or page without leaving the current one.

states.name: Shown
states.meaning: After a delay on hover or focus.

behavior.text: The card is extra: screen reader and touch users get the information by following the link.
openDelay and closeDelay avoid flicker when moving the pointer across the page.

content: Show a small summary: name, role, one line, maybe an avatar.

guidelines.do: Preview what the link already leads to.
guidelines.dont: Put unique actions in the card.
guidelines.why: Keyboard, touch and screen reader users may never see the card.

guidelines.dont: Use plain text as a trigger.
guidelines.why: Plain text can’t receive keyboard focus.

guidelines.dont: Show a full page in a hover card.
guidelines.why: Large cards cover the content people were reading.

accessibility.role: supplementary content; not announced by screen readers.

keyboard.action: Focusing the link opens the card.

wcag.how: Opens on focus too; the link works on its own.
Nothing essential lives only in the card.

examples.title: Profile preview
examples.code:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent, Link, Avatar } from '@ds/react';

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild><Link href="/u/sarah">@sarah</Link></HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent><Avatar name="Sarah Chen" /> Sarah Chen · Head of Products</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>

examples.title: Delays
examples.code:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent, Link } from '@ds/react';

<HoverCard openDelay={300} closeDelay={200}>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild><Link href="/p/1">Wireless headphones</Link></HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>$299 · In stock</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>

examples.title: Placement
examples.code:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent, Link } from '@ds/react';

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild><Link href="/docs">Docs</Link></HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent side="right">Guides and API reference.</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>

components.name: HoverCard
components.description:
A preview shown when pointing at a link, e.g. a profile card for a username. Sighted mouse
users only: never put anything there that isn't also reachable by following the link.

components.name: HoverCardTrigger
components.description: The link it previews; use asChild with a Link.
